title.narrative: EU Support to Decentralization (SO2): the human resource capacity of decentralised governance bodies and municipalities strengthened to effectively and accountably manage public resources and services.

description.narrative: The specific objective (outcome) of this Action is the human resource capacity of decentral-ised governance bodies and municipalities strengthened to effectively and accountably man-age public resources and services. This Action has the following outputs: 1.Public Service Human Resource framework improved to support decentralised govern-ance. 2.Government schools able to develop, pilot and roll out quality training modules in line with the capacity development strategy for decentralised government.

comment.narrative: 8 additional modules including one on gender.

The intermediary target for 2023 of this indicator has been surpassed with 4 high quality gendersensitive training modules made available placing the IFAPA in a much better position to propose induction and training module in line with the proposed ECD.In addition to the two gendersensitive POEMA training modules reported in the previous period Municipal Public Expenditure and Municipal Revenues the Municipal Internal Control module successfully tested with the target group and validated by the National Directorate for Municipal Development DNDA has been now finalized.A fourth training module on computer skills on computer skills in selflearning mode was developed with IFAPA Lichinga and satisfactorily tested representative of the target group.Two additional training modules Functioning of Provincial Assemblies in coordination with the National Directorate for Local Administration DNAL and Gender in Public Administration in coordination with the GAST are in the final phase of development under the leadership of the IFAPA Beira.A seventh module for the induction of elected municipal officials is in its initial phase of development in coordination with the DNDA and IFAPA Matola.

description.narrative: Number of decentralised government managers and technicians, and member of the provincial and municipal assemblies (disaggregated by gender), trained by the Public and Municipal Administration Training Institutes (IFAPAs) on the basis of shortterm training courses approved within the scope of the national capacity development strategy in the context of decentralisation, increased from 198 to 2.400 (of which 30% women).

comment.narrative: Final target.

The intermediary target to train 1200 managers and technicians as well as members of elected assemblies at municipal and provincial level was reached and surpassed. As of end of October 2023 1288 persons were trained of which 38 are female learners. Thus the indicator stands at 54 of the target value of 2400 of which 30 women by 102025. The measurement of this outcome indicator depends on the shortterm training courses that will be considered a priority for the implementation of the ECD. For this report the measurement of the indicator is based on the prioritized shortterm training courses listed in the actual version of the ECD.

description.narrative: Number of decentralised government managers and technicians, and member of the provincial and municipal assemblies (disaggregated by gender), trained by the Public and Municipal Administration Training Institutes (IFAPAs) on the basis of shortterm training courses approved within the scope of the national capacity development strategy in the context of decentralisation, increased from 198 to 2.400 (of which 30% women).

comment.narrative: Final target.

The intermediary target to train 1200 managers and technicians as well as members of elected assemblies at municipal and provincial level was reached and surpassed. As of end of October 2023 1288 persons were trained of which 38 are female learners. Thus the indicator stands at 54 of the target value of 2400 of which 30 women by 102025. The measurement of this outcome indicator depends on the shortterm training courses that will be considered a priority for the implementation of the ECD. For this report the measurement of the indicator is based on the prioritized shortterm training courses listed in the actual version of the ECD.
